title: Airy Indulgent Dutch Dough Pancakes
description: A yeasty and fluffy Dutch dish featuring chili powder and shio-cure, perfect for a buddhist-temple-friendly meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, shio-cure, chili powder, and sugar
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and melted butter
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Drop the dough by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings
